coverage_rule: prefix global layers 0..n-1; advance each module until first meaningful coverage; then stop; remaining percentages unmeasured
meaningful_rule: all three paired allocated savings positive AND mean saving >=1 GiB AND >=1% B1 allocated AND saving >3 times paired sample SD
profile_rule: only first meaningful coverage per module plus B1; three independent captures, 5 warmup, steps6-8,10 total; FC1 narrow GEMM Event control if FC1 meaningful
mbs4_gate: extrapolate B1 allocated MBS4 =2*B1_MBS2 -AB_MBS1; predict candidate subtract 2*measured MBS2 savings; probe only if predicted <=77 GiB; inference only, not memory feasibility proof
mbs4_rule: at most one three-step probe per qualifying selected strategy; if runnable verify full gradients against recompute-free MBS4 memory-saving CPU gradient snapshot is unavailable so compare same MBS reference only if it runs; no full correctness claim from MBS2 transfer; formal3x20+30 only successful probes
